title.narrative: Empowering Scientists and Research Institutions for Safe and Resilient Research During Crises

description.narrative: This programme aims to strengthen the capacity of Member States, research institutions, and scientists to safeguard scientific research and ensure the continuity of research activities during crises and emergencies. Through institutional capacity-building, policy support, awareness raising, and targeted support for women scientists, the programme will promote the freedom and safety of scientists, strengthen resilient research systems, and enhance the ability of scientific institutions to respond to and recover from emergencies. The programme will contribute to protecting scientific knowledge production and fostering inclusive and gender-responsive research environments in Eastern Africa.
